notes: Defect: promo/discount amount is missing or incorrect for return-trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. The mapping path from dispatch discount data through mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch (which feeds the Mozio order submission and subsequent email) likely does not carry the discount amount correctly when the dispatch is a return trip. The create-reservations mappers already special-case return trips (swapping from/to stations), suggesting return-trip dispatches follow a different code path that may omit or miscalculate the discount.

notes: Openspec provided no acceptance criteria (empty array), only a descriptive note about the defect. I built the full AC set from scratch based on the defect description and the listed technical files. Key areas covered: (1) Core fix — return-trip discount appears correctly in email (AC-1). (2) Regression — one-way trips unchanged (AC-2). (3) Edge cases — no discount, zero discount, over-discount (AC-3, AC-5, AC-7). (4) Root-cause-adjacent — discount preserved through station-swap logic (AC-4), mapper output parity between trip types (AC-8), different data paths for return trips (AC-9). (5) End-to-end — webhook payload consistency (AC-6). AC-4 and AC-9 specifically target the likely root cause described in openspec's notes: the return-trip code path (which swaps stations) may omit or miscalculate the discount.

notes: Refined openspec's two coverage-gate ACs into behavioral Given/When/Then statements (AC1 and AC2) that describe observable outcomes rather than prescribing that tests must exist. The original ACs violated the what-not-how rule by mandating unit tests and using grep compliance checks as verification. Added AC3: the core functional fix — promo code amount must display correctly for return trips in the Mozio email confirmation (the actual user-facing bug). Added AC4: edge case where both legs have discounts, ensuring the return leg isn't skipped or cross-contaminated. Added AC5: station-swap path edge case, since the technical notes flag create-reservations.mappers.ts station-swap as a potential root cause for discount matching failure on return dispatches. Added AC6: zero-amount promo code edge case to ensure the early-return branch doesn't swallow legitimate zero-value discounts that should still be reported.
